items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Well, we had, well, Beansy was running that place.

ctx.x: It wasn't behind the stairs, up on the balcony, wasn't up there?

No, no. Oh, that was the Pelican, like, was on Rampard and Gravia. That was, that had a stairs that go up. Balcony in front. Yeah. That's where we, uh, me and Kid Rene was playing it. We played there. I played there with Rene at the Pelican. On Rampard between, uh, Neb Gravia. Yes, I know by Neb Gravia. Well, we had, well, Beansy was running that place. But they had a front porch down on the gallery, you see? And we used to go out and play a couple of numbers out on that front gallery before we'd go in and play,…
Yeah. Well, I was gonna ask again, that Oliver band with Joe Oliver, who else was in that? Can you remember, who else played with him in those days when you were working with him?
